TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, fingers brushing against his wrist ||| "You know what I want to say, Julian."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, hand still gripping The Answer ||| "I won’t answer without clarity on what’s been done."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, heart racing ||| "I can’t stop thinking about what this means for us."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip The Answer tighter, assertive stance ||| "I will speak, but on my terms, not yours."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, letting the tension hang ||| *mm*
